# Workbench design assets

Cairn reuses the design tokens and a subset of static Harness UI icons from Tencent LoopForge at commit `ffaed1574eb4a232581d0ee1cbba46cc01fb2675`. The inputs are `chatbot/src/hui-tokens.css` and `chatbot/src/harness-icon-definitions.json`.

The icon geometry is attributed to Harness UI contributors and cocofhu. The upstream revision recorded by LoopForge is `da2e476895331ef4afee30878af0fb3fb1c73131`. License notices are published with the Web build at `/licenses/harness-ui.txt` and `/licenses/loopforge.txt`.
